name: BetterCharCounter
description: Adds live character counters to the message box, profile notes, your custom status and profile popouts that show how close you are to each limit and change color as you approach it.
author: Pharaoh2k
features: Live character counter on the message box
Shows your limit: 2,000 characters, or 4,000 with Nitro
Counts multi-line messages and long pastes exactly
Counters on profile notes, your custom status and the "Message @user" box in profile popouts
Turns yellow at 70% and red at 90% of the limit
Optional threshold to only show the counter near the limit
Automatic update checking with changelog display
